### 문서
- `SKILL.md` — Checks surprising verification results against the real execution path — stale intermediate layers and your own command or measurement — before re-debugging target code. Use when a fix looks correct but reality is unchanged, tests pass while reality fails, a rebuild shows no effect, a result looks suspicious, or you're about to cite a measured number in a commit message or report.
